Job Summary
Technical Project Manager
Location
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
Company
Iris Software
Job Description Key Responsibilities
Own end-to-end project planning, scheduling, and execution tracking across multiple cloud migration workstreams.
Create and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs, and delivery dashboards.
Coordinate daily with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, Architects, QE Leads, and Product Owners to ensure execution remains on track.
Track progress across multiple scope buckets and proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and dependencies.
Prepare weekly executive status reports, governance packs and steering committee updates.
Facilitate sprint planning, backlog reviews, delivery reviews, and cross-team synchronization meetings.
Monitor engineering health metrics including delivery velocity, milestone adherence, defect trends, and release readiness.
Drive action-item closure and follow-up across distributed onsite/offshore teams.
Support estimation, capacity planning, resource forecasting, and release planning.
Promote data-driven decision making through dashboards and actionable insights.
GenAI Engineering Productivity
Track GenAI adoption and productivity metrics across engineering teams.
Monitor Copilot/Agent usage, check-ins, code generation, and engineering productivity trends.
Publish dashboards highlighting automation gains, engineering efficiencies, and adoption KPIs.
Coordinate with Engineering Excellence teams to improve delivery effectiveness using AI-assisted development practices.
Identify opportunities to automate project reporting and governance using GenAI tools.
Required Skills
8+ years of Project Management experience in large enterprise technology programs.
Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and cloud migration programs.
Working knowledge of Azure/AWS cloud concepts and modern engineering practices.
Experience coordinating engineering teams across development, testing, infrastructure, and architecture.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Strong analytical skills with experience building executive dashboards and reports.
Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project/Smartsheet, Excel, and Power BI.
Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or other GenAI productivity tools is highly desirable.
Preferred Qualifications
PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or Prince2 certification.
Experience in Banking/Financial Services.
Exposure to enterprise cloud migration or modernization programs.
Experience working in global onsite-offshore delivery models.
Mandatory Competencies
Agile - Agile - SCRUM
Cloud - Google Workspace - Data Migration
